question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 B 组：瑞士 vs 波黑（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Switzerland vs Bosnia-Herzegovina (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 瑞士 Elo 高出近 300 分、实力明显占优，看好其取胜；但波黑防守顽强且瑞士近期对中游球队连续战平，平局风险不可忽视。
one_liner_en: Switzerland's near-300-point Elo edge makes them clear favourites, but Bosnia's stubborn defence and Switzerland's recent draws against mid-tier sides keep the draw risk material.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 296 分（瑞士 1891 vs 波黑 1595），中立场地 Davidson 模型给瑞士约 67.5% 基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 296-point Elo gap (Switzerland 1891 vs Bosnia 1595) yields a ~67.5% baseline Swiss win probability in the neutral-venue Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 波黑近 5 场 1 胜 3 平 1 负、6 月 6 日 1-1 平巴拿马，状态平平但附加赛曾淘汰意大利，防守韧性强。
key_reasons.en: Bosnia are 1W-3D-1L in their last five (1-1 vs Panama on Jun 6) — patchy form, but they eliminated Italy in the playoffs with a resilient defensive setup.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士近期对中游球队连续战平（3 月 0-0 挪威、6 月 6 日 1-1 澳大利亚），破密集防守效率存疑，故小幅上调平局概率。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland recently drew twice against mid-tier sides (0-0 Norway in March, 1-1 Australia on Jun 6), raising doubts about breaking down compact blocks — hence a small upward draw adjustment.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> three-way Davidson (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 67.5/20.2/12.3 -> bounded evidence adjustment (CHE -2.5pp, draw +2.3pp, BIH +0.2pp, within ±8pp cap) -> renormalized p_final 65.0/22.5/12.5. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
